scope: Phase D candidate read + version publish/head CAS (no search/UI/Host wiring)
behavior: getCandidate verifies active candidate entry/body digest and returns groups/basis/route metadata
publish CAS: exact candidate digest + expected epoch/scopeRevision/headRevision; rejects stale values
publish copies candidate body/sources/dependencies into a version body, creates an active version entry and advances consolidation_head revision by one
publish is idempotent by requestId/payload fingerprint; different payload conflicts
publishing a derived view does not advance store.revision or mutate memory records
getVersion verifies body digest/dependencies and returns historical flag; memory mutation blocks publish/read fail-closed
job transitions to published only in the publish transaction
limitations: No version search/list pagination, no UI/management API, no model-facing version tool.
No deletion/GC propagation to version bodies; no historical read policy beyond a simple actor check.
No excerpt dependencies in versions; only memory dependencies are supported.
No Host scheduler/profile dispatch wiring; tests use a synthetic provider and temporary stores.
No real model call or installed-profile consolidation was produced.
